rule.factor_source: Roache PJ (1994) Perspective: a method for uniform reporting of grid refinement studies. J. Fluids Eng. 116:405-413: the grid-convergence index GCI = Fs |e|/(r^p - 1), with factor of safety Fs = 3 for two grids at an assumed order and 1.25 for three or more grids at an observed order. Checked against secondary sources (NASA NPARC's grid-convergence tutorial; Phillips and Roy 2014, J. Fluids Eng.); the 1994 paper itself was not reached
rule.not_blind: the development gaps (872a6a8e runs, dt 0.5 and 1.0 s) were read before this rule; its soundness rests on its tolerance coming from step error alone; the judged runs are fresh, at G4's landed head, which differs from those runs only in its summation order
rule.orders_seen: the development orders (between the dt 1.0 and 0.5 s gaps to G2) were seen before the window was set to [p - 0.5, 3.5]: of 696 readouts above the floor, the largest order is 3.38, and four sit below p - 0.5, pol T=100's F_pol and E_tx at 2.466 at both test instances. Under this rule, such a world is inconclusive and takes the retry
